statement: Pinned wiiuse source and SDL/Cemu/Dolphin/Linux consumer selectors recognize Nintendo vendor 0x057e with product 0x0306 or 0x0330. Early Plus can use Nintendo RVL-CNT-01 name and 0306, while later TR uses Nintendo RVL-CNT-01-TR with 0330. Wii U Pro UC is a different device. Identity matching alone cannot certify built-in sensor or gyro output.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. wiiuse internal.h 159-177; README 103-112; SDL usb_ids.h 92-98, Dolphin WiimoteReal.cpp 1012-1037, Cemu PairingDialog 229-238, HidapiWiimote.cpp 5-48, Linux v6.12 core.c 811-862. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
